basic.question: When will I get married?
basic.framework: Check 7th house lord, Venus/Jupiter strength, dasha periods
basic.answer_template: Based on your chart, 7th house lord {lord} in {sign} with Venus {status} suggests {marriage_timing}. Current {dasha} dasha activates {activation}.
basic.strength_check: Venus strong -> early marriage; Jupiter aspect -> favorable timing; 7th house strength -> quick marriage

basic.question: What kind of partner suits me?
basic.framework: Check Venus placement, 7th house lord, and karaka strengths
basic.answer_template: Your Venus in {sign} shows partner {partner_type}. 7th house lord {lord} in {house} indicates {partner_qualities}. Mars {status} adds {mars_detail}.
basic.strength_check: Venus strong -> harmonious partner; 7th house strong -> supportive partner; Mars afflicted -> needs anger management

basic.question: Love marriage or arranged marriage?
basic.answer_template: Your 5th-7th connection {connection_type} shows {marriage_type}. Venus-Moon {aspect} indicates {love_style}. Rahu/Ketu connections show {non_traditional}.
basic.strength_check: Strong 5th-7th -> love marriage; Strong Venus-Moon -> arranged marriage possible; Rahu connections -> non-traditional

intermediate.question: Manglik dosha effects on marriage?
intermediate.framework: Check Mars placement in 1st/4th/7th/8th, Mangal dosha calculation
intermediate.strength_check: Mars in 1/4/7/8 -> Mangal dosha; Mars in own sign -> reduced effect; Aspects from Jupiter -> cancellation

intermediate.question: Second marriage possibilities?

intermediate.answer_template: 7th house lord {status} shows {second_marriage_probability}. 8th house connections {8th_status}. Dasha of 7th lord {dasha_status}.
intermediate.strength_check: Strong 7th lord -> second marriage possible; Weak 7th lord -> delayed; 8th house connections -> transformative marriages
